svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 16 / SPACE ROUTE
svg.desc: 13,951 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Every week is a planet. The ship docks at active weeks in chronological order and flies past intervening quiet planets. Each actual contribution adds one fuel; each station-to-station jump spends one fuel.
svg.text: 13920 fuel remaining · one contribution, one fuel
